$comment: Shapes the wire conventions (CONTRIBUTING-SPECS.md "Wire conventions for common members") do not mean, keyed by slug, then by "<rule> <member>", each with the reason. Read by scripts/lib/wire-conventions.mjs. An entry is for a member whose name matches a convention's but whose meaning is something else — never for a spec that would rather not follow one. An entry no longer found is reported as stale.

messaging/queue/list.truncated-flag truncated: Not a paging flag: it says the periodic queue survey stopped before covering every account. `nextCursor` already says whether more pages remain.

auth/_shared.duration-unit timeout: WebAuthn's PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions/RequestOptions `timeout` (milliseconds), carried verbatim as external vocabulary (SPEC §4.10 rule 5).
